tools.limitations: 不代表Office验收或模型已看图；预审依赖本机LibreOffice与可选PyMuPDF，不自动安装。

tools.outputs: JSON evidence; group test also writes a new PPTX copy and moved/restored renders
tools.limitations: Structure hints are not visual verdicts. Group test requires Windows PowerPoint; only the explicit translation and inverse are tested.

tools.title: PowerPoint 组移动保存重开及恢复检查

tools.outputs: JSON evidence; group test also writes a new PPTX copy and moved/restored renders
tools.limitations: Structure hints are not visual verdicts. Group test requires Windows PowerPoint; only the explicit translation and inverse are tested.

tools.title: 原生文字字号与位置测量小样
tools.inputs: --scene SCENE --references SLIDE_IMAGE_MAP_JSON --outdir NEW_DIR
tools.outputs: Frozen text-only PPTX specimens and a bounded measurement plan
tools.limitations: At most 128 page specimens and 64 plain top-level texts. Does not render Office or modify the candidate.

tools.title: 核对 Office 文字小样并给出参数建议
tools.inputs: --plan PLAN_DIR --office OFFICE_RENDER_DIR --output NEW_JSON
tools.outputs: Per-object font size, color and bounded pixel translation suggestions with confidence and alternatives
tools.limitations: Requires matching real Office receipts. Plain flat-background text only; no automatic adoption or visual approval.

tools.title: 生成混排文字、间距与半像素位置小样
tools.inputs: --scene SCENE --request SELECTED_TEXT_REQUEST_JSON --outdir NEW_DIR
tools.outputs: Packed editable text specimens retaining characters, run order, weight and baseline kinds
tools.limitations: 1..8 short unrotated single-color text objects on integer canvases 320..4096 pixels wide and 180..4096 high. Original physical canvas and font sizes are preserved. At 96 dpi export, compact targets fitting half-width cells use integer translations; wide headings or other export scales retain original coordinates and share pages only for disjoint text bounds and ROIs. At most eight specimens per page and 68 total pages; reduce targets or variants when needed. Height limits still apply; wide headings may span the canvas. Background measurement permits RGB fluctuations within 8 levels around a dominant color only when at least 40% of the ROI supports it. Optional font_deltas_pt uses 1..17 deltas within 2pt, preserves effective script sizes, and permits 1..4 nonoverlapping font_anchors inside each target ROI (at most 68 pages). Anchor scores use their minimum; only the first anchor moves the whole object. Alternatively spacing_deltas_pt targets explicit ASCII-space runs within 12pt, or script_deltas_pt targets explicit scripts within 8pt. These three modes require zero and cannot be combined. Optional shift_limit_px is 0..6, zero required for scripts. Scores cover selected ROIs only. No automatic render, adoption or visual approval.

tools.title: 测量原生曲线控制点与箭头线宽
tools.inputs: --scene SCENE --request BOUNDED_REQUEST_JSON --outdir NEW_DIR
tools.outputs: Hash-pinned native path suggestions, bounded solver usage and preview diagnostics
tools.limitations: Up to 16 isolated regions, 64 scalar parameters each. Solid top-level paths only; triangle arrows use a measured Office preview profile. Requires separate native Office verification.

tools.title: 生成原生曲线位置与线宽小样
tools.inputs: --scene SCENE --request BOUNDED_REQUEST_JSON --outdir NEW_DIR
tools.outputs: Native PPTX specimens at four half-pixel phases and three nearby stroke widths
tools.limitations: Isolated solid path groups only, at most 48 actual Office page exports. Does not render or modify the candidate.

tools.title: 核对 Office 曲线小样并给出微调建议
tools.inputs: --plan PLAN_DIR --office OFFICE_RENDER_DIR --output NEW_JSON
tools.outputs: Hash-bound native translations and stroke widths measured against real Office samples
tools.limitations: Requires current source, references and genuine Office exports. Small alignment and width changes only; no automatic adoption or approval.
